rules.title: Homes, up to two units
rules.plain: RH-2 lots are for homes, with up to two dwelling units on a lot.

rules.title: Height limit
rules.plain: No part of a building may be taller than the height limit mapped for this lot's height and bulk district.

rules.title: RH-2 dwelling cap
rules.plain: In RH-2, no part of a home may be taller than 40 feet, even where the mapped limit is higher.

rules.title: Rear yard
rules.plain: The back 30% of the lot, and never less than 15 feet, must stay open at ground level and on every floor.

rules.title: Front setback
rules.plain: The building must step back from the front lot line to line up with the neighbors' setbacks, up to 10 feet.

rules.title: Front height plane
rules.plain: Above 30 feet, the front of the building must slope back at 45 degrees from the front setback line.

rules.title: Slope can lower the limit
rules.plain: On sloping lots the height limit can be lower; this view assumes a flat lot and does not show that reduction.
